title: Required Fields Page
description: Empty vs filled REQUIRED fields (issue #296). An image block's `url` is required, so while editing an empty one is shown without the reveal toggle (the bridge seeds the same stand-in), and on the published page it renders nothing. A page of its own because the admin refuses to save a page with an empty required field, and other tests save optional-fields-page. `anchor-slate` gives the page a block-uid that renders in VIEW mode.
